in.langText: Pick where you're at. Time zone and keyboard follow along; tweak them if they're off.
in.tryKeyboard: Type here to test the keyboard
in.diskText: Pick the drive for NoCapOS. Everything on it gets replaced; your other drives stay untouched.
in.noDisks: No drive to install on. Plug one in, then look again.
in.tooSmall: Too small: NoCapOS needs at least {min}.
in.lockHint: Nobody can read your stuff if the drive gets pulled out of this computer.
in.tpm: Unlock on its own with this computer's security chip
in.tpmHint: No passphrase at start-up. You get a recovery key at the end, just in case.
in.passphraseHint: You type it every time the computer starts. Lose it and your stuff's gone, no cap.
in.advancedNote: Your other drives stay untouched. Later, in Storage, you can team up extra drives into a storage pool.
in.accountText: This is you: the boss of this NoCapOS.
in.usernameHint: Lowercase letters and numbers. You sign in with it.
in.userBad: Start with a letter; only lowercase letters, numbers, - and _.
in.usageText: Switch it up any time in Settings.
in.useBothText: NoCap Desktop on this screen, plus NoCapOS in the browser on your phone, laptop and the rest of your devices at home.
in.useDesktopText: NoCap Desktop on this screen only. Other devices can't open NoCapOS.
in.useWebText: No desktop on this computer. Run NoCapOS from your other devices' browsers.
in.usageLater: Settings > This Screen & Access switches between these later.
in.reviewText: Give it a once-over. Nothing's changed yet.
in.understand: I get it: everything on {name} gets erased.
in.slideApps: One-tap apps from the App Store, each in its own safe box.
in.slideFiles: Your files on any device, plus sharing with the squad.
in.slideShield: Shield keeps ads, trackers and randoms out.
in.slideLink: Link your phone: notifications, clipboard and files, both ways.
in.slideUpdates: Updates land in one piece and undo themselves if anything's off.
in.failedText: Your other drives are fine. Restart from the USB stick and try again; these details help if it happens again.
in.doneText: Pull out the USB stick, then restart. NoCapOS starts up and signs you in with your new account.
in.recoveryText: Write it down and keep it safe. It unlocks your drive if the security chip ever can't.
